Simple purées

Peach purée

Barackpüré

6 months+ Sound idea 20 min 4 portions

Serve warm or cool on a spoon, after one more look for stone fragments.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 320 g ripe peaches or apricots (prepared weight, peeled and pitted)
  • 2 tbsp water (only if the blend is too thick)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Cut the fruit off the stone and discard every piece of stone.
  2. Peel the fruit and cut away any bruised parts.
  3. Steam for about 8 minutes, until soft.
  4. Blend until smooth, with a spoon of water only if you need it.
  5. Look through the purée again for any stone fragment.
  6. Do not add sugar.

Sound idea

A piece of stone left in the fruit is a choking hazard. Unripe fruit will not blend to a smooth first purée.

Use ripe peach or apricot, peel it, and take the stone out completely. Steam and blend until smooth, with no sugar.
